title: Hearty Smoky Tunisian Potato Tagine
description: A smoky and indulgent Tunisian dish featuring baby new potatoes, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion. It is low-carb-friendly and served in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the potatoes to a lazy-susan-spinner vessel and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken broth and diced tomatoes.
Pour the broth and tomato mixture over the potatoes and continue to roast for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Traditionally, namul-blanch-season is used to cook the potatoes, but roasting brings out their natural sweetness.
To blanch the potatoes, boil them in salted water for 5 minutes before roasting.
